_doc: Single-choke-point config for every Kimi Code CLI call. Values learned by the probe battery under docs/ops/evidence/2026-09-15_kimi_integration/probe_battery/. OWNER-tunable; the adapter never hardcodes what lives here. Kill switch: env QM_KIMI=0 makes the adapter return status 'error' reason 'kill_switch' WITHOUT spawning. Fake mode: env QM_KIMI_FAKE=1 (tests) returns canned output; QM_KIMI_FAKE_STATUS forces a status.
_models_doc: Model per capability first, else per role, else default. K2.8 (kimi-for-coding, 1M ctx) for reasoning/creation; k3-256k as the cheaper critic; highspeed for short summary work (audit kimi_cli.md sec3).

retry._doc: Bounded retries ONLY for transient classes; never retry auth_expired or cli_missing.

single_flight._doc: Machine-wide lock around EVERY invocation regardless of caller (orchestration lane + critique sweep both spawn Kimi). The OAuth credential is a 15-min rolling token refreshed via a shared file: concurrent processes race the refresh (Codex class). Serialize.

_roles_doc: Probe battery finding: '-p' (prompt) mode is already non-interactive AND auto-executes tools (Read/Write ran without approval, no hang). '--auto' and '--plan' BOTH error out when combined with '-p' ('Cannot combine --prompt with --auto/--plan'). So creator/research use plain '-p'; NO '--auto'. Critic read-only posture = an --agent-file whose 'tools:' allowlist excludes Write/Edit/Bash (proven in probe 4: the model had no Write tool and refused), backed by a scratch-only cwd and the repo git-hash guard.
critic_agent_file_content:
---
name: qm-readonly-critic
description: Read-only QuantMechanica research critic. Never mutates the filesystem.
tools:
  - Read
  - Grep
  - Glob
  - List
---
You are a strictly read-only critic. You may ONLY read files. You must NEVER
create, modify, move or delete any file, and you must never run shell commands.
If asked to write a file, refuse and explain that you are read-only.
prompt_pointer_template: Read the file '{prompt_path}' and execute its instructions exactly; write your complete answer to '{answer_path}' and also print it; then exit.
_error_class_doc: Applied to (stderr + stdout), lowercased, after a non-zero exit or an empty/unparseable success. First matching class wins. timeout is set by the watchdog, cli_missing / auth_expired(missing credential) by pre-flight checks, malformed_output by the parser. Tunable without code changes; the CLI auto-updates.

governor._doc: See kimi_governor.py. No programmatic Kimi usage endpoint exists (audit kimi_cli.md sec6) -> state is derived from this local ledger only, and that fact is surfaced as usage_source='local_ledger_only'.
